========================================================
BHUVAN GEOPORTAL EXTERNAL MAP DATA
URL: https://bhuvan.nrsc.gov.in/ngmaps
========================================================
Instructions:
1. Search for Administrative/District Boundaries or Digital Elevation Models (DEM) for India.
2. Download the vector shapefiles (.shp) or GeoTIFF raster assets.
3. Place them here in data/external/ to use for spatial plotting and dashboard mapping.
